rebuttal_or_critique: While I acknowledge the arguments of Dr. Goyal and Prof. Varma regarding the moderation of core inflation to 3.60%, I remain concerned that shifting to a neutral stance at this juncture would be premature. With headline CPI at 5.10% and food inflation at a persistent 8.30%, the risk of inflation expectations becoming unanchored remains significant. A positive output gap of 0.50% suggests that demand-side pressures are still present, and we must ensure that our monetary stance does not signal a premature easing of our commitment to the 4.00% target. The current liquidity deficit of 150,000 crore INR is consistent with our objective of withdrawing accommodation to ensure durable disinflation. We must maintain our current course to ensure that the transmission of our past policy actions continues to work through the system.
